This gym is pretty decent overall, especially if you're focused purely on getting your workout in. It has a wide variety of equipment—everything from free weights to machines and cardio gear. So in terms of equipment availability, they've got most things covered.

However, the major drawback is the layout. The space is quite congested, with machines and benches stuffed in tightly, leaving very little room to move around. At peak hours, it can get uncomfortably crowded, and you often find yourself waiting for equipment or awkwardly navigating through narrow gaps between machines.

Cleanliness and maintenance are okay, and the staff and the trainer are polite and professional. The crowd is generally focused, which is nice, but the overcrowding does impact the overall experience, especially for those who like a bit more breathing room while working out.

If you go during off-peak hours, it's much more manageable. So, it’s a good gym for the price and equipment, but space and crowding could definitely be improved.

featured_reviews.name: Shreyash Patekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a member of this gym for over a year, and while the membership fees are budget-friendly, the management is by far the worst I have ever experienced.

The gym constantly advertises facilities that are either unavailable or not maintained properly. For example, the steam room has been non-functional for the last 5 months, yet new members are repeatedly told that it will be fixed "within a week." The same promise keeps getting repeated with no action taken.

Another major issue is the management's attitude toward members. There seems to be an unwritten rule that you cannot help your friends during workouts. I was simply showing my friend the correct form for an exercise when I was called into the manager's cabin, publicly confronted, and subjected to unnecessary drama. The situation became so chaotic that people from nearby buildings gathered to see what was happening.

The atmosphere is extremely unprofessional. I have personally witnessed staff being spoken to with abusive language, including a female trainer/manager. It creates a very uncomfortable environment for both members and employees.

The gym officially closes at 11:00 PM, but the manager starts switching off large sections of the lights around 10:15–10:25 PM, making it clear that members are expected to leave early despite paying for the full operating hours.

Safety and cleanliness are also concerns. There have been incidents in the gym that should have been handled much more professionally, raising questions about overall management standards.

The equipment and pricing may attract people initially, but management can make or break a gym experience. Unfortunately, the poor management, lack of professionalism, broken promises, and disrespectful treatment of members completely outweigh any benefit of the lower membership fees.

I stayed for over a year hoping things would improve, but they never did. If this is how a long-term member is treated, potential new members should think carefully before joining.
